combo.description: Q AA then W behind yourself and instantly E your enemy into your W. Follow up with a mid air AA.
R Q then W at your current location. Instantly Flash E them into your W followed by some AAs.
Flash and E Q instantly, then AA as quickly as you can. Use W and run them down for some more AAs.
To engage R then W and Flash instantly, followed by Q E and a quick AA.
Especially vs ranged Q then W your opponent, run up to them to E then instantly AA.
Most trades will start with Q and walk up to proc your passive then AA as soon as the poison hits. Use E to flip your target through your poison trail, then run them down to continue to AA.
The famous sky combo uses E then instantly Q AA to AA in the air.
